title: Pocket probe ledger — daily micro-sprint
content:
Purpose:
Quick personal ledger to track small probing runs for inference tuning. Notes are intentionally terse — this is my daily micro-sprint sheet (keeps runway short).

Context:
- Target: reduce p95 tail for 7B/13B family when batching > 4, without >20% token-cost increase.
- Env: local dev rig (4xA10G), staged on dedicated pool (2xA100) mainly for reproducibility.
- Quick labels: Q8 = int8 quant, Q4 = 4-bit, FP16 = baseline fp16.

Top-line experiment decisions (so I don't forget):
- If p95 improves >15% and tokens/sec drops <10% => consider rollout candidate.
- If cost/1M_tokens increases >25% => reject unless latency improvement >30% or quality unchanged.

Run matrix (most recent runs at top):

ID | date       | model     | quant  | batch | seq | prefix_cache | p50_ms | p95_ms | tok/s | est_cost_1M | notes
---|------------|-----------|--------|-------|-----|--------------|--------|--------|-------|-------------|------
R-2026-03-11-A | 2026-03-11 | redwood-7b-v1 | FP16   | 1     | 512 | off          | 48     | 120    | 725   | $1.1        | baseline, single request
R-2026-03-11-B | 2026-03-11 | redwood-7b-v1 | Q8     | 1     | 512 | off          | 38     | 98     | 840   | $0.9        | nice latency drop, no quality check yet
R-2026-03-12-C | 2026-03-12 | redwood-7b-v1 | Q8     | 4     | 512 | off          | 110    | 420    | 2200  | $0.85       | batching increased p95 a lot (queueing), investigate scheduling
R-2026-03-12-D | 2026-03-12 | redwood-7b-v1 | Q8     | 4     | 512 | prefix=on    | 90     | 210    | 2400  | $0.88       | prefix cache helped, but p95 still high vs target
R-2026-03-12-E | 2026-03-12 | redwood-7b-v1 | Q4+K   | 4     | 512 | prefix=on    | 85     | 190    | 2650  | $0.7        | Q4+kernel tweaks: great throughput, need eval on hallucination
R-2026-03-13-F | 2026-03-13 | vicuna-13b    | Q8     | 2     | 1024| prefix=on    | 200    | 520    | 980   | $2.4        | heavy seq, p95 high; not primary target for this sprint

Notes on anomalies:
- R-2026-03-12-C spike at p95 coincides with background checkpointing on node (noticed SRE message during run). Should rerun with maintenance off.
- Slight variance on tok/s across runs (±8%) probably due to mixed CPU load; need to pin CPU shares on dev cluster.

Quick ad-hoc calculations:
- Rough cost delta (R-B vs R-A): ~-18% cost, latency better; quality check = next step.
- For rollout gate: need p95 <= 200ms on batch=4 with prefix caching on dev rig (current best = 190ms).

Quality checks (todo):
- Run 50 sample prompts from prompt-set "pm-lite-v2" and compute BLEU/ROUGE-ish match rate vs FP16 baseline (script: eval/quick_diff.sh).
- Sanity-check harmful content rates with safety-probe script.

Short TODOs (ordered):
- [ ] Rerun R-2026-03-12-C with node maintenance disabled (ticket filed: JIRA-INF-331).
- [ ] Run quality sweep for R-2026-03-12-E (Q4+K) — collect hallucination and rope-in evaluation harness.
- [ ] Pin CPU shares and rerun 3x for stable tok/s numbers.
- [ ] Add small tracing to runtime to split queuing vs compute time (helps isolate p95 source).

Decisions logged for next sync with Mira (2026-03-15):
- If Q4+K passes quality sweep and p95 <= 200ms, promote Q4+K to canary on dedicated pool (limit 5% capacity).
- If hallucination metric increases >5% absolute, abort canary and pivot to Q8 with kernel tweaks.

Notes to self (quick scribbles):
- Avoid running heavy seq >1024 on the dev batch experiments; it skews queueing.
- Remember to export run traces to slog/ before wiping nodes.
- Slack thread: #eng-infer: "probe/q4-k-03-12" (pin results after quality sweep).

End-of-sheet snapshot: 2026-03-13 09:12 PT
(last quick save)

References and commands I ran:
- small-run: ./scripts/mini_run.sh --model=redwood-7b-v1 --quant=Q8 --batch=4 --seq=512 --prefix_cache=on
- eval: ./eval/run_eval_set.sh pm-lite-v2 --target-run=R-2026-03-12-E

Free-form scratch (things I might try later):
- micro-scheduling: try max-latency-aware queue policy (limit head-of-line when >x ms).
- hybrid quant: run attention-only Q4 + rest FP16 to test quality/latency trade.
- tiny model distill: small distilled 3B probe for tail behavior comparison.

---
Personal sign-off: Joel — keeping these tight so I can reproduce quickly.
content_preview: Quick ledger for daily probe runs (redwood-7b vs vicuna-13b). Tracks p50/p95, tok/s and quick decisions. TODOs: rerun with maintenance off, quality sweep for Q4+K, pin CPU.
